verdict.rationale: Appwrite Storage documents APIs to upload, download, delete and list files, plus a preview endpoint that resizes, crops and converts images. That covers the upload-and-serve core of the story. The pack has nothing on file-level access rules or permissions for storage, nor on CDN-backed delivery, so only about half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented storage access rules/permissions, CDN-backed delivery, independent or hands-on corroboration.
